svg.text: One 120 V / 15 A outlet. Everything is fed from the UPS in the machine module
booth app: kiosk browser + print agent
own USB-C power, talks to Stripe
• All mains wiring inside the machine module, on the PDU. Use UL-listed power supplies only, and
strain-relieve the main cord where it exits.
• The low-voltage LED runs (24 V and 12 V) go through the frame tubes to the softboxes, ceiling
panel, sign and plinth. The sign uses a quick-disconnect plug.
• The S710 reader talks to Stripe directly over Wi-Fi or Ethernet (server-driven integration). It
needs no USB connection to the PC.
• Fit an LTE router as a backup for bad venue Wi-Fi. The booth should stop taking payment when it's
• Leave a service loop on every cable so the printer shelf can slide out.
